items.stem:
Boiler : The boiler is essentially a closed vessel inside which water is stored. Fuel is burnt in a furnace and hot gasses are produced. These hot gasses come in contact with water vessel where the heat of these hot gases transfer to the water and consequently steam is produced in the boiler. Then this steam is piped to the turbine of thermal power plant.

Rajesh has been given the task of designing a boiler for NTPC. Boiler consist of a cylindrical part in middle and two hemispherical part at its both end. The cross section of boiler is given below. Length of cylindrical part is the 3 times of radius of hemispherical part.
(i) Which of the following is correct expression for the surface area of cylindrical part of boiler?
(ii) Which of the following is correct expression for the total surface area of boiler?
(iii) Which of the following is correct expression for the volume of boiler?
(iv) What is the ratio of volume to the surface area?
(v) If r = 3 m, what is the volume of boiler?
items.answer:
Let r be the radius of each hemispherical end; the cylindrical part then has length l = 3r.
(i) Curved surface of the cylindrical part = 2πrl = 2πr(3r) = 6πr².
(ii) The two hemispheres contribute 2 × 2πr² = 4πr² and the flat cylinder ends are not exposed, so the total surface area is 6πr² + 4πr² = 10πr².
(iii) Volume = πr²l + 2(⅔πr³) = 3πr³ + (4/3)πr³ = (13/3)πr³.
(iv) Ratio of volume to surface area = (13/3)πr³ ÷ 10πr² = 13r/30.
(v) At r = 3 m the volume is (13/3)π(3)³ = 13 × π × 9 = 117π m³ (about 367.7 m³).
items.ocr: Parts (i)-(iii) are worded 'Which of the following is correct expression...' but NO option lists are printed anywhere on the page for them — the book gives only the worked expressions, so the item is kept as the case-study it is printed as and nothing was invented. items.stem:
Kumbh Mela is a major pilgrimage and festival in Hinduism. It is celebrated in a cycle of approximately 12 years at four river-bank pilgrimage sites: the Prayagraj (Ganges-Yamuna Sarasvati rivers confluence), Haridwar (Ganges), Nashik (Godavari), and Ujjain (Shipra). The festival is marked by a ritual dip in the waters. The seekers believe that bathing in these rivers is a means to prayascitta for past mistakes, and that it cleanses them of their sins.

Government of UP is planing to procure tent for the pilgrims during Kumbh Mela. The specification of tent is given below.
(1) Lower cylindrical part must have a white colored thick fabric whose cost is ₹ 60 per square meter.
(2) Top conical part must have PVC coated blue fabric whose cost is ₹ 70 per square meter.
The front view of tent is given below with dimension.
(i) How much blue PVC coated fabric is required?
(ii) How much white fabric is required ?
(iii) If labour charge for the construction of tent is ₹ 15 per sq. meter what is the total cost of tent ?
(iv) If space requirement of a pilgrims is 6 sq. meter, how many pilgrims can be accommodate in a tent?
(v) If total 50000 pilgrims are expected to visit fair, how many tents are required ?
items.answer:
From the front view the base diameter is 42 m, so the common radius is r = 21 m; the cylindrical part is 5 m high and the conical top is 20 m high.
(i) The cone slant height is l = √(21² + 20²) = √(441 + 400) = √841 = 29 m, so the blue PVC fabric is the curved surface of the cone, πrl = (22/7) × 21 × 29 = 1914 sq. meter.
(ii) The white fabric is the curved surface of the cylinder, 2πrh = 2 × (22/7) × 21 × 5 = 660 sq. meter.
(iii) Labour adds ₹15 per sq. meter to each fabric. White fabric costs (60 + 15) × 660 = 75 × 660 = ₹49500 and blue fabric costs (70 + 15) × 1914 = 85 × 1914 = ₹162690, so the total is ₹2,12,190.
(iv) The floor of the tent is a circle of radius 21 m, area πr² = (22/7) × 21 × 21 = 1386 sq. meter. At 6 sq. meter per pilgrim, one tent takes 1386 ÷ 6 = 231 pilgrims.
(v) 50000 ÷ 231 = 216.45, so 217 tents are required.

items.ocr: Figure is required: the three dimensions (42 m base, 5 m cylinder, 20 m cone) appear ONLY in the printed front view, nowhere in the text. The number, the scenario and that figure sit on BOOK PAGE 519, which the chapter split omits (see notes); they were recovered from source PDF page 522, while the subparts and solution are on rendered page 42 (book page 520). TWO ERRORS IN THE PRINTED SOLUTION. First, the prose says 'Height of conical part is equal to its radius 21 m' and then computes √(21² + 20²) — the 20 m from the figure is what it actually uses and what gives its own l = 29 m, so the '21 m' phrase is a slip. Second, the cost line is printed as (60 + 15) × 1914 + (70 + 15) × 660 = ₹199650, which applies the WHITE rate of ₹60 to the 1914 m² of blue conical fabric and the BLUE rate of ₹70 to the 660 m² of white cylindrical fabric — the two rates are swapped relative to the specification in the stem. Applying the rates as specified gives 85 × 1914 + 75 × 660 = ₹2,12,190, which is the value recorded in the answer.
